name: Alice
source:
Alice had a childhood friend, Wakatsuki-kun.
Alice was clumsy and awkward since she was little, but Wakatsuki-kun was the only one who understood her.

Alice and Wakatsuki-kun grew up and attended the same school.

Then, suddenly, without notice, Wakatsuki-kun stopped coming to school.
Alice was worried, so a few days later, she decided to go and visit him.

And... she and Wakatsuki-kun became a couple. Alice was happy.
The young couple continued to live a life of love every day.

Then, one day, at the height of their happiness, something happened that suddenly changed their world...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/41582/]Getchu[/url]]
